nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf of token balances modified in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping allowance used in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sales, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private whitelist mapping checked in ensure and set in _mints.
Private minimum sale amount set in init and read in condition.
Private maximum sale amount set in init and read in condition.
Private sale count limit set in init and read in condition.
Private privileged trade address whitelisted in ensure and set through setTradeAddress.
Private owner address that gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public total supply minted in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used as exponent in mint/scale arithmetic.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
External caller address used for authorization checks and as transfer source.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
Internal view whitelist gate that returns true for privileged addresses and otherwise delegates to condition.
Public payable transfer entry point that mutates balanceOf and allowance without SafeMath.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall with user-supplied bytes.
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists spender in canSale.
Owner-only initialization of min/max sale amounts and sale count.
Owner-only batch send that multiplies value by array length and emits duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, owner, initial supply and infinite allowance.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing attacker/owner supplied bytecode in contract context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath (underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath (overflow risk).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * (10**decimals) unchecked scaling that overwrites balance.
totalSupply = _supply * (10**decimals) unchecked scaling in the constructor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution into transferFrom.

ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate executes the attacker-supplied delegatecall operation after the owner check.

transferFrom reads msg.sender to check and decrement allowance.
approve indexes allowance with msg.sender.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall.
msg.sender gate restricts _mints to owner or a hardcoded address.
msg.sender must equal owner to initialize sale limits.
msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
